The JavaScript contract tests initially failed because session-connection.mjs did not exist and native map/zone identities were not projected separately from editor rule IDs.

The retry regression failed after an admitted preparation failure because React reused consumed request identity 1.

contract.wire_identity: Instrument, attachment, revision and next-request values are canonical unsigned decimal strings and are never converted through JavaScript Number.
contract.ownership: Rust owns the constants, monotonic transport identities, disposable attachment lifetime and accepted snapshot. C++ carries the ABI fields without numeric narrowing; JavaScript validates the exact version, limits and u64 domain at entry.
contract.request_recovery: A terminal failure still consumes its monotonic request identity. React refreshes the accepted connection snapshot before a retry and validates the returned request, revision and next-request identity on success.
contract.replacement: Whole-document replacement and host-state restore stage a candidate engine and session before publication, retire prior request outcomes and publish a fresh revision-zero attachable identity immediately.

native_boundary.connection: Each InstrumentHostWebBridge opens one session attachment and disconnects it during deterministic destruction. Exact instance and attachment identities are required for mapping and undo admission.
native_boundary.worker: Mapping and undo run through the processor-owned asynchronous session worker and the existing off-audio activation gate; status records remain bounded at 128 and are retired when the session is replaced.
native_boundary.replacement: A restored or externally replaced document exposes its fresh connection before prepareToPlay. A held request from the retired session cannot collide with request 1 in the replacement session.
native_boundary.signed_oracle: The actual bridge maps kit/kick from MIDI 36 to 60, renders literal -0.5 at MIDI 60, invokes native undo, and restores literal -0.5 at MIDI 36. It also remaps a replacement session and renders literal -0.5 at MIDI 61.
native_boundary.integration_build: The final React production bundle was regenerated, embedded into the native resource target, release-linked into dandrum-trigger-native-bridge-test and passed its concrete bridge test.

react_boundary.identity: Native map and zone IDs survive projection independently of the editor-facing rule ID. Whole-document preparation reconciles accepted native zone IDs back onto renamed and copied editor rules.
react_boundary.adoption: Only native-identified key-range updateRule operations use the session command. Other fields and all unmigrated operations continue through whole-document preparation.
react_boundary.history: Migrated operations bypass Store's closure journal and use numeric ordering tokens alongside local commands. Native undo refreshes the canonical document without consuming an intervening local command; a detached editor leaves the native session as the undo owner.
react_boundary.replacement: A newer device generation refreshes the native session while retaining valid editor state; external replacement retires obsolete selection and history while preserving editor layout.
react_boundary.validation: The adapter rejects version drift, noncanonical, zero or overflowing identities, altered limits, invalid history counts, incoherent status identity/revision and exhausted request IDs.
